150.30.20.1(1).explanation: A seniors community house must occupy the entire building, may not be combined with another use, and may not have residents (other than staff) under 65 years old.

150.30.20.1(2).explanation: A seniors community house may not be located in the area bounded by Dundas St. W. on the north, Dufferin St. and the rail lines on the east, Lake Shore Blvd. W. on the south and Roncesvalles Ave. on the west.
